snippet.title: SUPERVIVE | Reveal Trailer and Open Beta Announce
snippet.description:
Join the upcoming playtest at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1283700/SUPERVIVE/?utm_source=ytat&utm_campaign=OB&utm_medium=social

SUPERVIVE is a MOBA BR meets HERO SHOOTER

Jump, glide, shoot, punch, bounce, nuke, spike your enemies in this free-flowing, chaotic battleground in the sky. Face off in all-out, multi-squad teamfights, take down boss monsters for big loot, get that W and run it back.

Open beta late 2024

Intro Animation by The Line: https://www.thelineanimation.com/

Music: "In Over My Head" by Grandson
Courtesy of Fueled By Ramen
Written by Benjamin Jordan, Justin "JT" Daly, Kevin Hissink, Justin Krupa
